_about: Public-domain Richard Hurd (1720-1808), Bishop of Worcester, for the Word Hoard: his Works (London: Cadell and Davies, 1811, eight volumes: the Warburtonian lectures on prophecy, sermons, charges, the dialogues and critical essays), and the separate Introduction to the Study of the Prophecies (1772), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 42 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
